result.summary: The pedestrian environment is extremely hostile, characterized by a complete lack of sidewalks and marked crossings at a wide, multi-lane intersection. Pedestrians are forced to navigate unpaved shoulders and grass, while the expansive roadway geometry prioritizes high-speed vehicle movement over safety.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved dirt or grass shoulders, as seen on both sides of the road.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The intersection is extremely wide with no marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge islands.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Control
hazards.description: No pedestrian signals or signage are visible to manage crossings at this large intersection.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalk markings and pedestrian countdown signals at the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The environment is extremely hostile to pedestrians, consisting of a high-speed multi-lane arterial road with no visible sidewalks or crossing infrastructure. Pedestrians are forced to navigate unpaved grassy medians or verges immediately adjacent to heavy traffic flow.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Complete absence of paved walkways forces pedestrians onto uneven grass or dirt surfaces directly adjacent to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Arterial Design
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway with minimal friction encourages high vehicle speeds, creating a lethal environment for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway spanning the center and right of the image

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the multi-lane road creates a massive unprotected distance for any pedestrian attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the visible roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to provide basic pedestrian separation.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes and narrow remaining lanes to lower vehicle speeds and reduce crossing distances.

interventions.title: Protected Pedestrian Crossings
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with pedestrian refuge islands and signalization to allow safe passage across the arterial.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane intersection with incomplete or poorly defined walkway infrastructure in the foreground. While traffic signals are present, the lack of high-visibility crosswalks and continuous paved sidewalks creates a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The foreground area lacks a paved, continuous sidewalk, forcing pedestrians onto unpaved or roadway surfaces.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires a long unprotected crossing time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no high-visibility markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross or to alert drivers to their presence.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalk in the foreground to separate pedestrians from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings at all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The environment is highly car-oriented, characterized by a wide multi-lane roadway and a significant lack of continuous pedestrian infrastructure. While a marked crosswalk and pedestrian signage are visible in the distance, the immediate foreground lacks sidewalks, forcing pedestrians onto unpaved surfaces or into the roadway.
